## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

PayloadCodec — core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/transport/PayloadCodec.kt

## Trigger

Receipt of a message on `/profile-sync` or `/recorded-race` by the
watch's and the phone's `WearableListenerService` — nothing observes
it, since neither listener exists yet (see the two separate gaps
reporting their absence).

## Today

`PayloadCodec` is `internal object` with two overloads of `encode` only:
`encode(payload: ProfileSyncPayload): ByteArray` and
`encode(payload: RecordedRacePayload): ByteArray`. Each turns the
payload into a private `Serializable` snapshot
(`ProfileSyncPayloadSnapshot`, `RecordedRacePayloadSnapshot`, and the
nested `RaceSnapshot`, `ProfileSnapshot`, `SegmentSnapshot`,
`RetainedFactorSnapshot`, `RejectedCalibrationSnapshot`,
`RaceHistoryEntrySnapshot`) and serialises it with `ObjectOutputStream`.
No function reads an `ObjectInputStream`, no function turns bytes back
into `ProfileSyncPayload` or `RecordedRacePayload`, and no function
turns a `RaceSnapshot` back into a `Race` or a `ProfileSnapshot` back
into a `Profile`. `WearableProfileSyncTransport` and
`WearableRecordedRaceTransport` (same package) only call `encode`, for
sending; neither calls anything named `decode`.

## Expected

`PayloadCodec` gains `decode(bytes: ByteArray): ProfileSyncPayload` and
`decode(bytes: ByteArray): RecordedRacePayload` (or two distinctly
named functions, since Kotlin cannot overload on return type alone),
each reading the bytes with `ObjectInputStream`, reconstructing the
matching snapshot, and mapping it back to the domain payload — a
`RaceSnapshot` back into a `Race` (with its `Segment`,
`RetainedFactor`, `RejectedCalibration` lists), a `ProfileSnapshot`
back into a `Profile`, a `RaceHistoryEntrySnapshot` back into a
`RaceHistoryEntry`. The watch's `WearableListenerService` calls the
`ProfileSyncPayload` decoder on a `/profile-sync` message and passes
the result to `ProfileSyncPushService.applyIncoming`; the phone's
`WearableListenerService` calls the `RecordedRacePayload` decoder on a
`/recorded-race` message and passes the result to
`RaceRepository.saveRecordedRace`. Both call sites are the two
listener services reported as missing elsewhere — this gap only adds
the decode path they will call.
